name: ZCA_IMPORT_DATA_INT
description: The table ZCA_IMPORT_DATA_INT is  standard import interface table, used to import all  objects.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: The Autogenerated number and a part of primary key of this table

columns.name: IMPORT_BATCH_LEVEL
columns.description: This column signifies the hierarchy of each row in the table

columns.name: IMPORT_MODE
columns.description: This column signifies the import mode of the batch in the table

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of an file Import Batch.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the record import in the interface table

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: It relates the record in the interface table to input file row

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Denotes is this is a special type of record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJ_LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE
columns.description: Language independent code of the object which is being loaded in the interface table, for the current import job

columns.name: PUID
columns.description: Public unique identifier to identify unique record

columns.name: PARENT_PUID
columns.description: Columns for storing Parent's PUID of the current data records (if child record is being imported)
